content: As listed by Melvin-Koushki, levels one to three of the hierarchy are: (1) jurists and traditionists, who know nothing beyond the literal outward form (ahl-i ẓāhir); (2) the dialectical theologians (mutakallimān), also partisans of the outward form but advanced beyond literalism by using reason; (3) the peripatetic philosophers, also called 'latter-day philosophers' or sages of the exoteric.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, R. Shaqq-i Qamar u Bayān-i Sāʿat
